# ADR-0009: Separate authority, operational and bulk capacity

Recorded: 11 October 2026. Retrospective project decision; not a bank governance approval.

## Status

Accepted target design; executable queue model only

## Context

A broad policy change must not put historical movement ahead of fresh operational records.

## Decision

Reserve authority-guard and operational delivery resources; cap bulk reconciliation/migration separately. Policy activation commits scoped authority plus a cursor rather than enumerating the affected dataset.

## Alternatives

One FIFO worker/queue for all work; prioritize operations without separating database and I/O budgets.

## Consequences

Ordering cannot be assumed across lanes; current authority and data versions resolve races. The original v3 runtime still has a serial worker/global lock. The migration slice has a separate bounded entity lock, not production isolation.

## Evidence

WORK_ISOLATION.md; dist/isolation/model.mjs; poc/migration.py

## Gate

Run open-arrival foreground load during large reconciliation; measure p99/errors and disk contention, not only queue lengths.
